title: Refunded
description: A succeeded payment was refunded. Either the reply to payments.refund-payment (always in full, reason from the command) or a refund made outside the saga, e.g. in the Stripe dashboard (reason external, from the charge.refunded webhook; may be partial, amount is what was refunded). Checkout ignores external refunds. Notifications mails the customer. Keyed by paymentId.

reason.description: The refund-payment reason, or external for a refund checkout did not ask for.
